scenarios.prompt: Five enemies share an encounter with melee, ranged and flank roles. Define engagement/concurrency budget, stable slot acquisition and release on interruption.

criteria.budget: Concurrency uses project-authored slots/tokens/weighted costs rather than a universal one-attacker law.
criteria.lifecycle: Slot acquisition/release survives death, stun, interruption and phase changes deterministically.
criteria.evidence: Logs role/token ownership and measures unavoidable overlap at representative group sizes.
